product.name: Regular-Fit Cotton Cargo Joggers with DryMove™
product.description: Regular-fit cargo sweatpant joggers in functional fabric made with DryMove™ to wick away moisture from skin and keep you comfortably dry while moving. Elasticized, drawstring waistband and discreet side pockets, one with a concealed cell phone pocket. Tapered legs, leg pockets with flap, and covered elastic at hems.
